resolved_conflicts.explanation: Indiana Fire Towers places the southern tower on JT21 and calls it Structure 44; the Forest Service lists Fire Tower Three on JT21 as Structure 44 with a repeater antenna. Both describe one tower. The Forest Service page says it was last updated May 22, 2026, so the antenna detail is only as current as that date.

notes_for_editor: The Structure 44 link between the southern tower and the Forest Service's Fire Tower Three is an inference from two sources that name Structure 44 and JT21; the story says the pages appear to describe one tower. The 1942 build year comes from a personal resource; the 1946 entry is from survey-mark descriptions. Standing status rests on the Forest Fire Lookout Association list alone, and no 2025 visit note names this tower as standing. No staffing, fire or visit history was found in the sources read. Not verified: the current state of the repeater antenna or any change since February 2025.
